question: OPPORTUNITY_CONSERVATION_FAILURE names allocation.assert_allocation_conserves AND draw_coherence.assert_draw_coherence as enforcing it. Do they enforce the same invariant?
answer: NO. They are different invariants, on different objects, at different points in the chain, and either can pass while the other fails. One integrity code cannot own both.

assert_allocation_conserves.precise_invariant: within each club-room composition the renormalised shares of ALLOCATED rows sum to 1.0 within 1e-9; no club carries negative reassigned mass; and every gsis_id the declared downstream consumer intends to read is inside the allocated composition.
assert_allocation_conserves.inputs: the allocation Outcome -- rows carrying share_renormalised and allocation_state, plus per-club evidence n_with_measured_share and reassigned_mass -- and an explicit consuming_ids set
assert_allocation_conserves.before_or_after_simulation: BEFORE. It is the gate on the composition that FEEDS the generator.
assert_allocation_conserves.deterministic_or_simulated: DETERMINISTIC. Scalar shares, one per player-room, no draws involved.

failure_semantics.ALLOCATION_DOES_NOT_CONSERVE: FAIL / DATA -- a room whose shares do not sum to one has lost or invented opportunity
failure_semantics.CONSUMER_READS_OUTSIDE_THE_COMPOSITION: FAIL / DATA -- the consumer intends to read a player the composition does not contain
failure_semantics.NO_CONSUMING_SET_DECLARED: BLOCKED / GOVERNANCE -- a composition nobody declared a use for cannot be certified against anything

assert_allocation_conserves.note: THIS FUNCTION CARRIES MORE THAN ONE INVARIANT. Summation-to-one is conservation. CONSUMER_READS_OUTSIDE_THE_COMPOSITION is a SCOPE check -- it asks whether a downstream layer stays inside the set, which is a different question with a different failure mode. NO_CONSUMING_SET_DECLARED is neither; it is a governance refusal to certify. A wiring slice must decide whether one integrity code covers all three or whether scope gets its own.

assert_draw_coherence.precise_invariant: on the FINAL PUBLISHED draw matrices, no cell holds a football-impossible state: counts non-negative; completions <= attempts and the QB line internally consistent; receptions <= targets; team targets <= team pass attempts; and where the shared passing event was live, the team passing line closes on the receiving layer cell by cell within tolerance.
assert_draw_coherence.inputs: the published arrays, a team row map resolved from manifest layers row_ids, and an explicit shared_pass_live flag which is REQUIRED and never inferred
assert_draw_coherence.execution_point: nfl/production/run_forecast.py:3061, on the matrices about to be sealed
assert_draw_coherence.before_or_after_simulation: AFTER. Its own docstring exists because earlier QB verdicts were evaluated on INTERMEDIATE draws that football_engine then overwrote.

failure_semantics.DRAW_COHERENCE_VIOLATED: FAIL -- one or more components carry an impossible state on the final draws
failure_semantics.DRAW_COHERENCE_NOT_EVALUABLE: BLOCKED / DATA -- a check that did not run has not passed
failure_semantics.DRAW_COHERENCE_VACUOUS: BLOCKED / DATA -- zero cells evaluated is an error, not a clean result

assert_draw_coherence.note: It already distinguishes HARD from DIAGNOSTIC from DEFERRED, and carries NOT_APPLICABLE and DEFERRED components by name without counting either as a pass -- the same discipline IntegrityReport coverage asks for.

are_they_identical.different_time: before the generator versus after it
are_they_identical.different_failure: a room that does not sum to one versus a cell that is impossible
are_they_identical.allocation_can_pass_while_coherence_fail: YES, and it has. draw_coherence.py records that 101 of 101 sealed artifacts carried QB_DRAW_ACCOUNTING_HOLDS while 5,278 cells held more completions than attempts. A composition summing to one says nothing about whether a draw cell is possible.
are_they_identical.coherence_can_pass_while_allocation_fail: YES. A generator fed a composition summing to 0.98 produces draws that are perfectly coherent cell by cell -- they are a faithful simulation of a wrong allocation. And CONSUMER_READS_OUTSIDE_THE_COMPOSITION has no draw-level analogue at all: coherence never looks at who the consumer intends to read.

OPPORTUNITY_CONSERVATION_FAILURE.documented_meaning: a club-room composition does not conserve: its allocated shares do not sum to one, or a club carries negative reassigned mass
OPPORTUNITY_CONSERVATION_FAILURE.why_not_renamed: the identifier is already in the gate registry and in historical gate records, and the same ruling was taken on INACTIVE_PLAYER_OWNS_OPPORTUNITY. Renaming is schema churn without changing the rule.

SIMULATION_DRAW_COHERENCE_VIOLATED.documented_meaning: the final published draw matrices contain a football-impossible cell
SIMULATION_DRAW_COHERENCE_VIOLATED.why_this_name: it is the word the producer ALREADY uses -- its own refusal is DRAW_COHERENCE_VIOLATED -- so the integrity code and the producer's refusal read the same. SIMULATION_DRAW_COHERENCE_FAILURE was suggested and is rejected only because 'failure' is a synonym the code itself does not use; nothing else separates them.
SIMULATION_DRAW_COHERENCE_VIOLATED.sits_beside: MISSING_ROW_IDS and SIMULATION_ROW_MISMATCH, which are already owned by the simulation artifact. Those check the row AXIS; this checks the CELLS. Three codes, one owner, three invariants.

proposed_code_ownership.open_question_for_the_wiring_slice: whether CONSUMER_READS_OUTSIDE_THE_COMPOSITION gets a third code. It is a SCOPE invariant, not a conservation one, and folding it into OPPORTUNITY_CONSERVATION_FAILURE would make one code mean two things -- which is the defect this audit exists to prevent.

compose_protection: IntegrityReport.compose refusing a code claimed by two producers is what surfaced this. It must not be weakened: had it allowed both, whichever producer ran last would have silently decided what the code meant.
